title: Software Engineer II, AI Experience (Remote Eligible)
description:
Headquarters: -REMOTE, USA-

 For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

 Smart Assist is Smartsheet's AI agent for work management, used by enterprise customers to analyze, create, and act on their work. AI Experiences builds the orchestration for Smart Assist and the user-facing implementations that expose Smartsheet's Intelligent Work capabilities to any AI surface, so users can reach the right intelligence at the right time through a coherent, reliable experience.

 AI Experiences is a pillar within Applied AI, and this is a full-stack team. The work spans these areas: the Smart Assist frontend (UI components, interaction patterns, and rendering for AI experiences across Smartsheet); the Smart Assist backend and orchestrator; UX for Smart Assist tools and agents, from response formatting and onboarding to error states. On the backend, the orchestrator routes each request to the right sub-agent based on user intent, keeps conversation state across multi-turn interactions, handles fallbacks when sub-agents are unavailable, and controls feature-flagged rollout of new capabilities. We partner closely with Agent Engineering on much of this logic.

 The role. You will own features and components of Smart Assist from prototype to production, across the front end, the orchestrator and back-end services. You will turn ambiguous product asks into reliable, well-measured behavior customers can trust, and work with product, design, and AI Experience to ship.

 You Will:

• Own a core piece of the Smartsheet AI experience, or a significant part of one (for example conversational analytics, chart-to-dashboard creation, or a new entry point into the assistant) from design through production.

• Build full-stack: user-facing components, the services behind them, and the contracts between the two, with typed APIs, clear error states, and tests.

• Design and ship agent tools, skills, MCP tools, and MCP Apps with contracts the model can use reliably, and decide when an action belongs in a tool, a service, or the model.

• Shape how agent output appears to users: streaming responses, loading and failure states, and handling of long or partial results, working with design and product.

• Build and evolve the Smart Assist orchestrator: intent-based routing to sub-agents, multi-turn conversation state, fallback and degradation handling, and feature-flag rollout of new capabilities, partnering closely with Agent Engineering. Populate the context the agent receives, such as user locale, timezone, and workspace state.

• Define how quality is measured for your area: build golden cases and scorers, set regression gates, and use traces and production signals to decide whether a failure needs a prompt, tool, context, or UI fix.

• Instrument features with tracing, structured logs, and latency, cost, and error dashboards, and act on what they show.

• Take part in on-call, security, and cost work for Smart Assist, shared with Agent Engineering. Reproduce production failures and review code for your team.

• Partner with PMs, designers, Agent Engineering, AI Platform, MCP, and data teams. Learn how customers use what you build and flag gaps in requirements and tests.

• Use AI coding tools to ship faster without lowering the quality bar.

 What we're building next:

 Our goal for the coming year is to make Smart Assist safe to trust and hard to leave. You will help shape work across four themes:

• Be everywhere: an assistant that understands what you are looking at, such as the rows you have selected, and meets you in the flow of work, including smoother import and file upload.

• Build the habit: an assistant that remembers how you like to work, with personal, team, and organization profiles, quick commands, and a growing UI component catalog.

• Earn the trust: previews before changes apply, linked sources and explanations for results, AI edits visible in history and activity logs, and a view into the agent's reasoning.

• Work together: a directory of agents, @mentions, and the ability to save and share results as pages.

 Further out, the vision is a Smart Assist that finds you before you ask: a proactive, insight-first surface that learns how your workspace works, suggests prompts personalized to you, brings in context from tools like Slack, Zoom, and documents, supports multiplayer conversations, and offers help inside the chat itself. You would help define the trust model for that experience from real customer learnings and feedback.

 You Have:

• 2–4 years of professional software engineering shipping production systems.

• Strong in Python and/or TypeScript/React, with good habits in testing, code review, and debugging.

• Experience building and shipping customer-facing features end to end, including APIs, data modeling, and user-facing behavior.

• 1+ years building LLM-powered features in production: tool or function calling, agent loops, prompt and context design, or multi-step workflows.

• Working knowledge of how agents fail (bad tool choice, context overflow, hallucinated arguments, runaway cost) and how to design around it.

• Experience designing eval scorers and golden datasets, and using results to make and defend a decision.

• Experience with MCP tools and MCP Apps, structured tool calling, or reusable agent skills.

• Comfort with production observability and with data-heavy environments (Databricks or equivalent).

• Evidence of using AI coding agents to ship faster without lowering the quality bar.

• Clear communication of quality, cost, and reliability findings to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis.

 Strong plus:

 Experience with conversational or chat UI at scale; LLM tracing tools (LangSmith, Phoenix, Braintrust or similar); prompt versioning or CI-integrated evals; dashboard, charting, or data-visualization products; enterprise SaaS permissions and entitlements; prompt-injection mitigation and output validation.

 What success looks like:

• First 90 days: ship a feature or improvement to production with eval coverage, and take your first on-call rotation.

• First 6 months: own a feature or significant part of a project with measured gains in task success, latency, or user adoption, and contribute at least one reusable component or pattern.

 Why this role:

• You build the Smart Assist experience used by enterprise customers, with real users and a measurable quality bar.

• You work across the stack, from the interface to the agent tools behind it, so you see your work reach customers end to end.

• The problems are distinctive: enterprise-grade permissions and security, and one assistant that works across a broad work-management product.

• You work on the hard parts of production agents, on a team that values engineering rigor and diverse perspectives.

 Current US Perks & Benefits:

• Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees

• 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)

• Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity

• Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off

• US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans

• US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year

• Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave

• Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community

• Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses

• Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account

• Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

 Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

 US Base Salary Pay Range
 $125,000 — $175,000 USD

 Get to Know Us:

 At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

 Equal Opportunity Employer:

 Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.

 If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

title: Staff Security Engineer
description:
The role

Our InfoSec team is looking for a Staff Security Engineer to lead how we defend Paddle in a rapidly changing threat landscape. AI is changing both sides of security. Attackers are using it to scale social engineering, find weaknesses faster and automate intrusion, while our own adoption of AI tools and agents creates new risks to manage. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for an experienced security generalist who wants to build our defences against these threats, and to use automation and AI to make our detection and response faster and more effective. You’ll be a senior technical leader across InfoSec and IT, working across both our Enterprise IT and Product environments, and helping our global team of Paddlers operate securely without slowing them down.

What you’ll do

  • Lead our incident response capability, from playbooks and readiness exercises to acting as senior technical lead during security incidents.

  • Improve our security operations, strengthening detection coverage, alert quality and triage, and turning manual operational work into engineered, repeatable processes.

  • Build and evolve our defences against AI-enabled threats, including AI-driven phishing, impersonation and deepfakes, and accelerated vulnerability exploitation.

  • Help Paddle grow our adoption of AI securely by designing guardrails, access models and monitoring for AI tools and agents, including the non-human identities and integrations they rely on.

  • Use automation and AI to speed up detection, investigation and response, so the team can handle a growing threat volume without growing headcount at the same rate.

  • Contribute to the secure configuration, posture management and monitoring of our AWS cloud infrastructure, working with the Platform team so security initiatives are delivered in a scalable and reliable manner.

  • Strengthen identity and access security as capabilities evolve, including our approach to MFA, device trust and conditional access.

  • Support GRC initiatives on technical control implementation and audit evidence automation, in line with SOC 2, PCI DSS and CIS Benchmarks.

  • Partner with InfoSec, IT and Engineering leadership to set technical direction and deliver the department’s key security programmes, making design decisions and driving work across multiple business functions.

  • Mentor and support other engineers across InfoSec, IT and the wider Engineering function, building a culture of continuous improvement, knowledge sharing and technical excellence.

Skills & Experience

At Paddle we value a growth mindset and a willingness to learn, so if you're confident in most of these skills (not necessarily all) and you're excited to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We’d love to hear from you if you:

  • Have extensive experience as a security engineer or in a similar role, with breadth across incident response, security operations, security engineering and cloud security, and a strong track record of hands-on delivery.

  • Have led or played a senior role in responding to real security incidents, from investigation and containment through to recovery and lessons learned.

  • Bring strong cloud security expertise, including identity, resource configuration, logging and monitoring. Hands-on experience securing AWS, including containerised workloads and cloud-native deployments, is highly desirable.

  • Have experience with detection and response tooling, such as SIEM, EDR and cloud security posture management platforms, and know how to make them effective rather than noisy.

  • Understand how AI is changing the threat landscape, and are excited about using automation and AI to improve how security teams detect, investigate and respond.

  • Are familiar with modern identity, device management and endpoint security solutions (e.g. Okta, Iru, Island, SentinelOne), as well as collaboration and networking tools (e.g. Google Workspace, Slack, Cloudflare Zero Trust).

  • Can script or program to automate workflows and integrate systems. Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform preferred) is desirable.

  • Have experience implementing technical controls against frameworks such as SOC 2, PCI DSS or CIS Benchmarks (nice to have).

  • Are comfortable operating autonomously on high-impact, wide-reaching work, and working collaboratively across multiple business functions.

  • Can communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and are comfortable influencing at all levels of the business, including during high-pressure incidents.

  • Are passionate about security and want to make a real impact at scale.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

The Role:

We are looking for a smart, ambitious, and autonomous Business Development Representative to help fuel our next stage of hyper-growth. This is an exciting time for you to join the team: our customer base is expanding globally, our product is evolving fast, and our sales engine is scaling like never before.

As a BDR in our Business Development team, you will be the first point of contact for all of Paddle’s sales efforts. You’ll create demand, spark meaningful conversations, and build early relationships that turn into qualified pipeline to arm your counterparts on the Account Executive team. Your core tasks will involve researching, prospecting, prioritizing accounts, educating prospects, and converting interest into high-quality meetings.

This role places you at the centre of a high-performing GTM function. We take career development seriously. Once you consistently hit quota and master the craft, you’ll have a clear pathway to grow into an Account Executive role at Paddle.

What you'll do:

  • Quickly develop a deep understanding of Paddle’s Ideal Customer Profile, core use cases, and value propositions to target the best-fit companies for us.

  • Own and properly manage a healthy territory of high-fit accounts.

  • Proactively generate conversations and effectively showcase Paddle’s set of products across all channels: LinkedIn, cold calling, email, video, and region-specific channels (WhatsApp, WeChat, etc.).

  • Convert these meaningful engagements into qualified opportunities for our Account Executive team.

  • Partner with our marketing department to collaborate on in-person and virtual events to generate demand.

  • Use modern tools, including AI-powered workflows, to work smarter, personalise outreach, and improve performance.

  • Manage and prioritise your time to consistently meet and exceed your targets.

  • Bring a winner’s mindset and high-performance attitude to the team every day.

We'd love to hear from you if you are:

  • Experience in a previous Sales / Business Development role as part of a SaaS or B2B company, and are always happy to proactively engage new customers through email and phone.

  • Coachable, accountable, and consistent in your efforts to develop knowledge and results.

  • Believe in a consultative and human sales approach and understand that every conversation is different.

  • Are performance-driven, competitive, and energised by hitting and surpassing targets.

  • See the benefits of Paddle’s set of products - we strongly believe that our products are helping other Tech companies grow, and we want to work with people who are passionate about Paddle and can articulate its value.

  • Can stay organised in a dynamic, fast-changing environment and thrive in moments of ambiguity.

  • Can follow a framework, while baking in your own flavour and creativity.

  • Are excited to get outside your comfort zone, experiment, and continuously improve your craft.

  • Are confident communicating across multiple channels and formats: phone, email, video, social.

  • Enthusiastic and ambitious, with a desire to build a career in sales.

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We’re a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

  • Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”

  • Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”

  • Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, unlimited holidays, enhanced parental leave, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives.

We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

Connecting at Paddle

We’re a ‘digital-first’ company, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations.

We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.

Our Paddle hubs:

  • In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)

Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work.

To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.

title: Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend | United Kingdom | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend

The Opportunity:

Grafana is an open-source observability product and a platform that teams and plugin developers build on. The Frontend group shapes its user experience (from dashboards and visualisation to navigation, search and sharing) and the foundations that support engineering teams and community contributors across the Grafana ecosystem.

As Senior Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the Frontend Platform and Navigation squads, owning their performance, delivery and customer outcomes. Frontend Platform enables teams to build reliable, high-quality experiences; Navigation helps users find and organise resources and move confidently through Grafana.

You’ll develop senior engineers, partner with Product and Design, and improve how teams work, including through AI and automation. We use Cloud-first rollout and experimentation to learn quickly, bringing relevant improvements to OSS and Enterprise.

AI Notice: We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Be accountable for the performance of two distributed engineering squads: set clear expectations, delegate effectively, coach and develop each team member, give timely feedback, address performance gaps and build a culture of trust and accountability.
  • Own hiring and team planning across both squads, aligning team capacity and skills with product priorities and longer-term needs.
  • Lead discovery with your squads: engage directly with customers, community members and internal users, combine their feedback with research and usage evidence, and use those insights to shape roadmaps and priorities.
  • Partner with Product, Design and engineering leaders to set priorities, resolve dependencies and make trade-offs between customer needs, long-term investments and operational demands.
  • Own delivery across both squads from discovery through rollout and measurement: set milestones, surface risks early and intervene when commitments are at risk.
  • Use AI regularly in your management work to synthesise research and feedback, inform roadmap and resourcing decisions, and streamline coordination, reporting and follow-through.
  • Improve how the squads plan, make decisions and deliver. Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work.
  • Set engineering direction with senior engineers for the frontend foundations owned by your squads, including developer experience, accessibility, architecture, tooling, reliability and multitenant capabilities.
  • Set engineering direction for navigation, search and resource organisation, including where AI-assisted discovery can help users find what they need.
  • Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work.
  • Lead improvements across Grafana and R&D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes.
  • Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Significant experience managing senior engineers, building healthy teams and developing technical leaders. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly.
  • A strong technical foundation in modern web or frontend systems, enabling you to evaluate technical trade-offs and shape architectural and engineering-quality decisions with senior engineers.
  • A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into clear priorities and measurable results, managing delivery risks and operational demands.
  • Strong product and customer judgement, with the ability to connect engineering investments to user, developer and business outcomes.
  • Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation.
  • An appreciation for open-source development and the judgement to balance Cloud-first delivery with the needs of customers, community members and internal teams.
  • Practical experience using AI and automation in your own leadership work, and leading teams to adopt them effectively.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience with React, TypeScript or comparable large-scale frontend ecosystems.
  • Experience leading a developer platform team, including support for plugins or extensions.
  • Experience with navigation, search, information architecture or resource-management products.
  • Experience delivering multitenant SaaS or major platform migrations.
  • Experience working on a widely adopted open-source product.

Compensation & Rewards:

In the United Kingdom, the Base compensation range for this role is GBP 117,949 - GBP 141,539. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process.

All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

#LI-Remote

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

title: Full-Stack Engineer (Frontend Leaning) - Studio
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
You’ll build the tools that make Studio a video editor people want to live in. These include transitions, color grading and elements libraries all built on top of our in-house engine. You’ll also build presets, so a user can get the effect they want without tweaking 20 individual controls.
The work mixes greenfield features with polish on the existing editor. An example of the polish is letting editors coming from Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro rebind their keyboard shortcuts in one step. You’ll write proposals, get fast feedback, and own features through launch, including the marketing moment.
You’re a product-minded, frontend-leaning full-stack engineer. Deep backend skills aren’t required.

Requirements

  • Strong frontend engineer who has built complex, interactive UIs.

  • Enough full-stack ability to work across the stack, but deep backend expertise isn’t needed.

  • Evidence of product responsibility: side projects, open source, or product-facing work.

  • Thrives in a fast-moving, startup-style environment, and takes ownership with minimal hand-holding.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re looking for an experienced Data Engineer to join our Data team. You will build and scale our data pipelines, establish best practices, ensure data quality, and enable self-service data access across teams.

  • Own and streamline data pipelines from ingestion to delivery, ensuring they are reliable, scalable, and efficient.

  • Build self-service tooling and write clear documentation to empower cross-functional teams (Engineering, Revenue Operations, Growth, and others) to independently meet their data needs.

  • Create AI agents to serve data questions for others

Requirements

Demonstrated experience formalising and scaling data pipelines, ideally as one of the first or early data engineers on a growing team.

  • Expert knowledge of dbt (required).

  • Proficiency with tools across the modern data stack (Python, SQL, BI tools).

  • Strong infra fundamentals (Terraform or other infrastructure as code, GCP or other cloud providers)

  • Structured thinking; ability to simplify complex, messy data into clear structures.

  • Strong ability to understand varied stakeholder requirements and build generalised solutions.

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, Warsaw, New York.

• Manage and prioritize incoming tickets to assist with deliverability troubleshooting and strategy

• Carry and service a portfolio of assigned customers with a paid Deliverability Services Consulting entitlement

• Help conduct in-depth investigations, reviews, and audits into email sending practices

 Our ideal candidate is someone who has competency in deliverability concepts and customer management skills.  #LI-Remote

title: Senior Strategic Account Executive (Accounts 1 billion+)
description:
Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Overview

As a Senior Strategic Account Executive, you own the development and growth of a portfolio of assigned strategic accounts within your designated region. You build and execute strategic sales plans, develop trusted relationships with senior executives and key stakeholders, and identify opportunities to expand Rithum's value across complex client organizations. You are accountable for meeting or exceeding financial targets by leading consultative, value-based sales engagements and securing high-value, multi-year software and services agreements.

Rithum empowers employees across all roles to leverage AI and technology to work smarter, move faster, and create scalable ways of working. In this role, you will use AI and data-driven insights to strengthen account strategy, identify opportunities, improve sales effectiveness, and deliver more relevant and impactful client engagement.

Responsibilities

Strategic Account Growth

  • Develop and execute account plans aligned to client priorities, commerce strategies, and growth objectives.
  • Meet or exceed sales targets by identifying, developing, and closing software and services opportunities.
  • Expand Rithum’s footprint across client brands, business units, geographies, channels, marketplaces, and capabilities.
  • Build qualified pipeline by identifying whitespace and new opportunities within assigned accounts.

Executive & Value-Based Selling

  • Build trusted, multi-threaded relationships with senior executives and key stakeholders.
  • Understand client priorities and position Rithum’s capabilities against business outcomes.
  • Lead consultative, value-based conversations and develop compelling business cases.
  • Navigate complex buying groups and build consensus across decision-makers.

Deal Execution

  • Lead complex sales opportunities from discovery through negotiation and close.
  • Develop deal strategies that address client priorities, competitive dynamics, commercial considerations, and barriers to close.
  • Lead negotiations across pricing, terms, procurement, legal, security, and other stakeholders.
  • Apply the Rithum Way of Selling to opportunity strategy, qualification, progression, and close.

Pipeline, Forecasting & AI

  • Maintain a disciplined pipeline and deliver accurate, timely forecasts.
  • Maintain high-quality CRM data and use insights to prioritize accounts and opportunities.
  • Leverage AI and sales technologies to strengthen research, account planning, client engagement, and productivity.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead cross-functional deal teams, bringing together the expertise needed to advance opportunities and deliver client value.
  • Partner across Client Success, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Product, Partnerships, Legal, Finance, and other teams as needed.
  • Share client, market, and competitive insights with Product and business leadership.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of B2B software, SaaS, or technology sales experience
  • 5+ years in a closing role selling to strategic or enterprise accounts, or 2+ years selling Rithum solutions to enterprise clients, with quota attainment
  • Proven success in a full cycle quota carrying role; from strategic territory planning, prospecting, developing & closing complex 6 figure transactions (minimum 100k deal size)
  • Consistent recent quota attainment (100%+ for 4+ consecutive quarters) in a competitive, metrics-driven environment.
  • Demonstrated success developing and growing strategic accounts through new opportunities, expansion, cross-sell, upsell, or new use cases.
  • Experience leading complex sales cycles involving senior executives, multiple stakeholders, and commercial negotiations.
  • Mastery of structured, value-based sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDICC, Challenger, SPIN, Miller Heiman, Value Selling, Solution Selling) with evidence of pipeline progression and forecast accuracy, translating solutions into measurable business outcomes and leading cross-functional deal teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to build pipeline through self-generated outbound prospecting, with measurable activity standards (e.g., 40–60+ daily touchpoints)
  • Demonstrated ability to develop account plans, identify whitespace, build pipeline, and maintain accurate forecasts.
  • Disciplined use of CRM and sales tools (Salesforce preferred) and sales engagement platforms (e.g., Outreach, Salesloft, HubSpot, LinkedIn Navigator, ZoomInfo) for pipeline, activity, and conversion tracking.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI, data, and modern sales technologies to improve sales effectiveness.
  • Ability to operate independently and travel as required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10+ years of B2B SaaS, software, or technology sales experience.
  • Experience selling enterprise commerce, e-commerce, marketplace, retail technology, or related solutions.
  • Experience selling to large brands, retailers, manufacturers, or enterprises with complex buying environments.
  • Experience selling integrated solutions across multiple products, capabilities, or services.
  • Familiarity with partner- or channel-influenced sales motions.
  • Experience positioning data-driven or AI-powered solutions.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field preferred.

Travel Required

Up to 25%

Other Duties

Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

What it’s like to work at Rithum

When you join Rithum, you can expect to work with smart risk-takers, courageous collaborators, and curious minds.

As part of the Rithum team, you are valued, supported, and included. title: Demand Generation & Campaign Operations Manager
description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

You run our websites, search, webinars and email across the Spotify Technology portfolio. Your job is to bring people into the funnel and move them through it: from finding us in search or at a webinar, to signing up, to becoming an active user, to a meeting with sales. You also own the numbers. Every week you tell the team what’s working, what isn’t and what we’re changing. You work AI-first, you know our martech stack inside out, and you use the newest features of both.

What You'll Do

  • Website, personalization and SEO: Own performance on our marketing sites, including landing pages, forms and conversion paths. Create personalized experiences using the latest tools. Own GA4 and GTM tracking and run A/B tests to lift conversion. Implement SEO and AI search strategies and decide which pages we need to build next.

  • Email and nurture, moving people toward sales: Build nurture paths mapped to each stage from lead to opportunity with a clear next step. Segment by role, company fit and intent so engineers, platform leads and execs each get the right message. Partner with Sales and RevOps on what sales-ready looks like, keep a regular drumbeat for people who aren’t ready yet, and write the emails yourself. Success is measured by meetings booked and pipeline, not opens and clicks.

  • Webinars, getting the most out of every one: Run every webinar end to end, from platform and landing page to invites and reminders. Grow registrations and show rate with the right audience, and manage the follow ups. Turn each webinar into on-demand pages, clips, blog posts and nurture content. Report results and keep a playbook of what works.

  • Campaign operations: Own campaign naming and UTM rules. Build and launch your own emails, workflows, segments and lists, backed by standard QA checklists. Keep lists clean and own subscription types and consent setup, including growing opted-in lists across the portfolio. Partner with Legal on consent, privacy and data sharing so every list enters HubSpot correctly and legally.

  • Reporting: Build reporting at campaign, channel and executive levels, and own the weekly scorecard. Track spend and tool costs against pipeline, decide with the team what to scale, fix or stop.

  • AI and martech: Work AI-first every day and know our stack inside out, using the newest features as they ship. Structure our data so AI tools return correct answers. Build AI agents and automations that cut manual work, evaluate new tools on cost and impact, and be the team’s go-to person for what the tools can do.

Who You Are

  • You have 5+ years of experience in demand gen, marketing ops or lifecycle at B2B SaaS, selling to developers or technical buyers

  • You’ve set up marketing from scratch: tracking, email, reporting, the works. You’re comfortable in fast-moving, ambiguous environments

  • You’ve built nurture programs that moved leads to sales meetings, and can show the pipeline

  • You enjoy hands-on, individual contributor work and building programs yourself

  • You’ve run webinar programs end to end

  • You’re hands-on with GA4 and GTM. You’ve set up tracking, not just read reports

  • You’ve personalized a B2B website and can show what it did for conversion

  • You’re hands-on with a modern martech stack (HubSpot or Marketo, Braze, an attribution tool, and enrichment or intent tools like Clay or Reo.dev), using recent features, not just the basics

  • You’ve built campaign and executive reporting that leadership used to make budget calls

  • You use the latest AI tools every day for analysis, content and automation, and you’re the person others ask about what’s new

  • You have SEO experience, and you know how AI search is changing it

  • You’ve set up consent and subscription management in a CRM, and worked with legal on GDPR, CAN-SPAM and partner data sharing

  • You write well, and can show emails you wrote that performed

Where You'll Be

This role is based in London or Stockholm.
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

description:
Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimise operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimised consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Overview

As the Field Marketing & Events Manager, you own Rithum’s field marketing and events program across assigned regions and play a defined role in executing the events calendar. You design and deliver a portfolio that spans client conferences, industry trade shows, internal company gatherings, executive dinners, and multi-city roadshows. You are accountable for the demand those programs generate, including leads, pipeline, and client engagement, and for the localized marketing strategy that connects them to Rithum’s business objectives within assigned regions. Working with senior marketing leadership and regional sales, you define what success looks like for field marketing, build the processes that make strong events repeatable, and deliver experiences that raise Rithum’s brand visibility with clients and industry leaders.

At Rithum, all team members are expected to leverage AI to work smarter, accelerate decision-making, automate repeatable work, and improve outcomes. You are encouraged to continuously identify opportunities to apply AI, data, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, drive innovation, and deliver greater value for our clients, partners, and teams while maintaining appropriate judgment, quality, security, and compliance.

Responsibilities

Regional Strategy & Events Planning

  • Define and execute the field events plan within assigned regions, setting clear objectives and measurable goals for brand visibility and business impact
  • Partner with field marketing and sales leadership to plan and execute events within the global field plan, with clear ownership agreed for each event
  • Develop and execute localized marketing strategies that drive demand, generate leads, and accelerate the sales pipeline across markets within assigned regions

Event Delivery & Execution

  • Plan and execute a broad range of events, from high-touch executive dinners to mid-scale multi-city roadshows, each with defined objectives, tracking, and measurement
  • Lead end-to-end event execution, including budgeting, pre- and post-event marketing, on-site and offsite experience and logistics, vendor management, and post-event analysis
  • Coordinate across time zones with sales, field, and event vendors so that execution standards, timelines, and handoffs are consistent between regions

Measurement & Continuous Improvement

  • Track event performance against attendance, leads generated, opportunities and pipeline generated, and client feedback, and present actionable insight to stakeholders
  • Build repeatable processes, templates, and post-event review practices that deliver consistent results across all regions and calendars, not just through individual effort, and apply a single measurement standard throughout

AI-Enabled Practice

  • Use AI to improve the quality of event planning and performance decisions, not only the speed of delivery, surfacing alternatives and stress-testing assumptions before committing budget
  • Model and share effective AI practices with the wider marketing team, and be clear about what must be verified before AI-assisted material reaches clients or partners

  • Build strong working relationships with stakeholders across sales, marketing, content, product, and client success, as well as external partners, to deliver seamless events aligned with business goals
  • Leverage company websites, online content, industry trends, and emerging technologies to enhance the client experience and event effectiveness

  • 5+ years in field or corporate events marketing within an enterprise B2B software or e-commerce organization, with experience across multiple regions and markets
  • Previous experience in events and field marketing within the e-commerce sector, engaging e-commerce audiences

  • Strong working knowledge of the B2B technology ecosystem and of regional differences in event strategy, audience engagement, and execution

  • Proven experience planning and executing events with clearly defined budgets, objectives, and measurable KPIs, pre- and post-event
  • Working knowledge of core marketing metrics and their application in measuring event success and field marketing impact
  • Experience with event management tools and platforms such as Asana, Marketo, Cvent, Salesforce, HubSpot, and virtual event platforms
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent events to deadline across more than one market and time zone
  • Experience collaborating with senior cross-functional stakeholders, including Sales and Client Success, to align marketing initiatives with broader business objectives
  • Ability to travel globally on a regular basis for events, with authorization to work and travel internationally
  • Experience using AI tools to improve marketing or events work, including planning, analysis, content development, and reporting, with verification of output before it reaches clients or partners

title: Product Marketing - Agents
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for a Product Marketer that can position & package the ElevenAgents Platform to Enterprise. Companies around the world use ElevenLabs Agents to resolve customer support, provide engaging and interactive experiences, and put an end to “waiting on hold”. We continue to discover new use cases and industries that can benefit from our technology and you’ll be helping drive the narrative as we grow. You’ll help launch new products, produce thought leadership content, create assets to enable our sales team, and build industry focused landing pages.

Who You Are

We're looking for an exceptional individual who combines a great product & design sense, excellent copy writing skills, and the technical background and interest to become an expert on Conversational Agents.

You’ll thrive on our team if you:

  • Are extremely passionate about AI Audio and technology more generally.

  • Have experience launching products and creating content for technical / enterprise audiences.

  • Have excellent project management skills and can juggle multiple tasks at once.

  • Consistently strive for excellence, delivering high-quality work quickly and exceeding expectations.

  • Take initiative and work autonomously from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside.

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Bangalore, Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco, Tokyo, and Warsaw.

description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Strategic Account Executive (German Speaking).

About the job

This position is needed to sell into high value prospects and customers. This person will play a key role in further growing the business across EMEA with a particular focus on DACH. The candidate will be responsible for managing fast growing customers in the region. Focused mainly on Product cross and up-sell and revenue growth, as well as sourcing net new opportunities within a set of accounts.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Servicing the fastest growing customers in the region.
  • Growing our revenue and share of wallet within your key account list.
  • Opening doors to the purchase of Twilio’s products and services - including voice, messaging, email, contact centre, account security software.
  • Maintaining the highest levels of customer satisfaction.
  • Create pricing proposals, negotiating terms and managing the contract process.
  • Selling solutions to a technical and business audience.
  • Building trust and mutual respect with technical customers and peers.
  • Thinking outside of the box and having extraordinary interpersonal and communication skills to make complex contractual, technical, and financial details sound simple.
  • Balancing challenging priorities and handling multiple projects/deals at the same time.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 7+ years of Account Management/Sales experience covering selling and closing complex technical solutions to a large customer base.
  • History of working with accounts ranging from large multinational enterprise customers to Digital Natives.
  • Demonstrated success by achieving quota on a consistent basis.

Desired:

  • Experience and understanding of working in the communications market is preferable. Have sold or worked with Messaging, Voice Calling, Email, Account Security Verification. Or have prior experience in a traditional telecommunications environment/business.
  • Curious networker
  • Strong emotional intelligence

Location

The position will be remote and based in the United Kingdom, Ireland or Spain.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 25% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.
.

.

•

•

•
 2+ years of experience in content design, UX writing, content strategy, information architecture, or a related field, with experience designing for web and native digital products.

•
 A portfolio that shows strong UX writing craft, strategic thinking, and shipped product experiences across in-app, web, or other customer touchpoints.

•
 Strong understanding of UX writing, information architecture, content hierarchy, usability, accessibility, research, experimentation, and product development.

•
 Ability to work independently on defined projects, navigate ambiguity with support, connect content decisions to customer needs and business goals, and move work forward with care.

•

title: Creative Engineer, Stripe Creative Lab
description:
Headquarters: New York, US, Canada, Remote

 Who we are

 About Stripe

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

 Brand Studio team works on a variety of brand-centric projects for Stripe, from our brand standards to campaigns, events, IRL experiences, packaging, digital products, and even printed publications. The brand designers on this team are multidisciplinary in nature, able to design robust visual systems, art direction, and craft surfaces that focus on brand and product storytelling.

 Collaborating with other teams at Stripe, as well as external partners, we raise the quality and consistency of experiences with the Stripe brand IRL, virtually, and everywhere in between. We craft the creative vision and strategy for different types of projects and audiences, and amplify them across various mediums, channels, objects to environments, and digital and physical experiences.

 About Stripe Creative Lab

 Stripe Creative Lab aims to create breakthrough, culturally resonant, and exquisitely crafted projects that reveal Stripe’s magic in surprising ways. We dedicate ourselves to meticulously crafting the work to ensure the highest possible creative quality. The work is experimental, often starts with ambiguous briefs and requires finding a way where others might deem it impossible. We are making it up as we go, and that’s the way we love to work.

 What you’ll do

 You’ll be joining a highly creative team working across digital experiences, interactive projects, physical installations, experimental technology, and whatever else an idea might require. The work often begins without an obvious technical solution and sometimes without knowing exactly what form the final project should take.

 As a Design Engineer, you’ll work closely with designers, art directors, and producers to figure out what’s possible, prototype ideas quickly, and turn ambitious creative concepts into working experiences. You’ll bring deep technical expertise in at least one area of creative engineering, alongside the curiosity and technical range to work confidently beyond it.

 A significant amount of our work lives on the internet, so you should be comfortable independently building and shipping highly crafted digital experiences. Other projects may involve hardware, physical computing, unusual displays, installations, or technical systems we haven’t encountered before. You won’t be expected to be an expert in everything, but you should be excited to learn, experiment, and know when to bring in specialists.

 Responsibilities

• Prototype and build highly crafted, experimental digital experiences, interactive projects, and creative tools

• Work closely with designers and art directors to translate ambitious creative direction into technically excellent experiences, while contributing your own judgment to make the work better

• Explore emerging technologies and unfamiliar technical approaches, quickly determining what is possible and how best to build it

• Independently navigate ambiguous technical problems, moving pragmatically from early experiments to finished work

• Build and publish standalone web experiences when appropriate, while identifying and communicating the additional engineering support required for more complex projects

• Experiment with hardware, physical computing, displays, sensors, embedded systems, and other technologies when projects call for them

• Collaborate with external engineers, fabricators, technical studios, and other specialists, contributing enough technical fluency to be an effective creative and engineering partner

• Maintain a high bar for performance, reliability, usability, and craft without allowing conventional technical approaches to unnecessarily constrain an idea

 Who you are

 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

 Minimum requirements

• 6+ years of relevant software engineering, creative technology, or creative development experience

• Deep expertise in at least one area of creative engineering, with demonstrated curiosity and competence across adjacent technologies

• A portfolio of technically ambitious, highly crafted work such as experimental websites, interactive experiences, realtime graphics, games, installations, creative tools, or other unusual applications of technology

• Strong frontend engineering fundamentals and experience independently building and shipping public-facing web experiences

• Strong visual and interaction sensibility, with the ability to faithfully execute sophisticated creative direction and identify opportunities to improve it

• Experience solving unfamiliar technical problems with a high degree of independence

• Experience writing thoughtful, maintainable code and making pragmatic engineering decisions in fast-moving environments

 Preferred qualifications

• Experience with realtime graphics, WebGL, WebGPU, Three.js, shaders, animation, generative systems, or other forms of creative coding

• Experience working with hardware, physical computing, embedded systems, sensors, displays, Raspberry Pi, Arduino, or interactive installations

• Familiarity with backend development, APIs, networking, cloud infrastructure, or other areas beyond frontend engineering

• Experience collaborating with designers, artists, fabricators, creative studios, or other multidisciplinary partners

• Experience identifying, evaluating, and directing outside technical specialists when a project extends beyond your own expertise

• Deep curiosity about technology, design, craft, and the ways new technical capabilities can enable new forms of creative work

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/stripe-creative-engineer-stripe-creative-lab

title: Sales Development - UK/I
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

Our Sales Development team play a crucial role in building an effective outbound sales strategy, whilst working closely with the Account Executives.

In this role you will:

  • Conduct research to identify potential leads and prospects within the target market

  • Continuously refine and adjust outreach strategies based on the feedback loop

  • Monitor and report key performance indicators (KPIs) related to outbound sales activities, including conversion rates, lead quality, and outreach effectiveness

  • Collaborate with the sales leadership to analyze data and optimize strategies for better results

Requirements

  • 2–3+ years of outbound B2B sales experience, with a strong track record of securing net-new business meetings

  • Proven ability to build and qualify opportunity-sized lead lists in new markets and verticals

  • Fluency with modern prospecting tools and multi-channel outreach strategies

  • Experience building and scaling outbound processes in fast-paced environments

  • Intellectually curious, asking thoughtful questions and developing insights-driven approaches to outreach

  • Highly self-motivated, able to work independently while thriving in a collaborative team culture

  • Strong prioritization and time management skills, with the ability to handle a high volume of leads efficiently

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

  • Fluency in additional European languages is desirable but not essential

Location

This role is remote-first, however there is a preference for candidates to be based in London or Dublin with the option to work out of one of our offices.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
